snippet.title: ⚽ Escape the Circle - Dribbling Warm-Up
snippet.description:
One player, one ball, eight exits, and a ring of defenders trying to shut every one of them.

Build a circle roughly 25 across with about 8 gates spaced around the edge. One player dribbles in the middle, everyone else stands on the outside and slides along the ring to block them from escaping through any gate. Break out through a gate and the nearest defender takes your place in the middle. 6-8 players per circle.

It looks like a game, but the middle player is getting a full dribbling workout without realising it. Every defender who shifts to block one gate opens another somewhere else, so the player on the ball is constantly scanning, changing direction and committing to the gap the moment it appears. That decision - spot the space, attack it before it closes - is the whole skill.

Want to sharpen one thing in particular? Limit the moves the middle player can use. Inside-outside only, weak foot only, one specific turn - and suddenly the same game trains exactly what you need.

❗ Focus
- Lower your centre of gravity to turn sharply with the ball
- Scan the whole ring for the empty gate, not just the one in front
- Commit to the gap the instant it opens
- Close, controlled touches so the ball stays with you through the turn

Best for U9-U13.
